# Bird Personality Test
> Free online bird personality assessment based on avian behavior science with 16 questions, 5 trait dimensions, and personalized care recommendations.
## Pages
- [Home](https://birdfanciers.com/): Bird Personality Test Tool Online – take the quiz and get your bird personality profile
## Statistics
- 1 page, interactive quiz with 16 behavior items and weighted trait scoring
